description: TCS says OSWAS 3.0 will be powered by its DigiBOLT platform and will provide government departments with a unified digital workplace.
body_lead: TCS Wins Rs 122-Crore Bid To Build AI-Enabled Digital Governance Platform For Odisha Govt TCS says OSWAS 3.0 will be powered by its DigiBOLT platform and will provide government departments with a unified digital workplace. Got Question about the News? Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has won a Rs 122.6 crore contract to implement the next phase of the Odisha State Workflow Automation System (OSWAS 3.0), extending its partnership with the Odisha government by around six years.
